# v1.1.0-dev.124: Undocking gives a window its shape back

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.122`. There is no
dev.123 download: it was tagged and then folded into this one, which carries
the same fix plus the packaging fix below.

## A window that was maximized comes back maximized

Dock a window that was maximized, then undock it, and it came back as a
screen-sized window that was no longer maximized, sitting where its pane
had been and hanging off the edge of the screen. Its own restored size was
gone too, so restoring it down afterwards changed nothing.

The size a window is handed back on undock is its own restored size now,
and a window that was maximized when you docked it is maximized again when
it leaves. That holds for undocking one window, undocking a whole virtual
window from the tray, a window released because its pane went away, and
quitting WLM with the undock setting. Profiles and the Virtual Windows
library remember it, so it survives a reload.

## The download no longer carries test leftovers

The dev.122 zip had a test sandbox inside it, about 38 KB of logs and a
throwaway settings folder under `resources\app`. Nothing identifying was in
it, and nothing in it ran, but it had no business in a download. The
packager now leaves out every working directory the tests write, and a test
holds it to that list.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
